title: ISA Granturismo 66 Yacht: Ushering in a New Era of Superyacht Innovation
description: ISA Granturismo 66: a 66m superyacht redefining the GT line with sporty automotive-inspired design, expansive alfresco living and long-range performance.
html:
ISA Yachts has elevated its Granturismo (GT) line with the debut of the ISA Granturismo 66, a yacht that builds upon the series’ tradition of merging sleek styling with powerful full-displacement capabilities. Fourteen years after the GT series first disrupted conventional superyacht norms, this new 66-meter addition reimagines the idea of a “grand sea coupé,” introducing modern enhancements while maintaining the signature traits of the GT collection.

Exterior Design and Deck Highlights

The ISA Granturismo 66 channels influences from both the automotive world and aerospace engineering, continuing a signature of the brand since the celebrated Okto emerged in 2014. The vessel’s silhouette, shaped by Enrico Gobbi – Team for Design, features lines inspired by sports cars, all emphasized by a metallic blue-grey paint. The side decks are sculpted to suggest airplane wings, further underlining the yacht’s sporty appeal.

Emphasis on alfresco enjoyment is evident across the yacht. Generous seating and sun lounging areas are set at the rear of both the upper deck and the sundeck, with space for up to 14 guests. Glass balustrades on these decks—and forward—offer panoramic views of the water. The main aft deck hosts an infinity pool, and the foredeck features a lounge complete with a firepit, maximizing opportunities for open-air leisure and entertaining.

Interior Arrangement and Features

The interior, also conceptualized by Enrico Gobbi – Team for Design, can be personalized to the owner’s wishes. The skylounge serves multiple functions, acting as a classic saloon, a gym—complemented by a forward-deck hot tub—or as a dining room. At the front of the main deck, a full-beam master suite is accompanied by two guest cabins nearby, perfect for families or support staff. On the lower deck, three further guest suites—two doubles and a twin—are joined by a flexible convertible room, allowing for a variety of accommodation setups.

A purpose-built wellness center is located on the lower deck, complete with a spa and fold-down terraces that bring guests closer to the water. Bespoke furniture, fluid lines, and a combination of warm woods, marble, and satin brass create a space that is both stylish and contemporary across all interiors.

Performance and Dimensions

The ISA Granturismo 66 has an overall length of 217 feet 8 inches (66.4 meters), a beam measuring 36 feet 1 inch (11 meters), and a draft of 10 feet 8 inches (3.3 meters). Driven by twin 2,375-hp MTU engines, the yacht boasts a maximum range of 5,500 nautical miles at a cruise speed of 12 knots. Up to 12 guests are accommodated in six staterooms, with an interior layout designed to ensure both privacy and sociable spaces.

The ISA Granturismo 66 marks a significant milestone in the evolution of the GT range, blending cutting-edge design, flexible amenities, and tried-and-true engineering to cater to today’s discerning yacht owners.
